entradas.text: I was standing at the exact same podium overlooking the Hill of Pride where my inauguration took place. However, the mood this time was far from cheerful.
I looked at the people of Sordland below. They were gazing up at me with confusion and concern.
My name was announced. I stepped forward as the cameras flashed. The crowd started clapping.
“They dare to attack Sordland. My Sordland! There is a price to pay and they will pay with their lives!”
entradas.menu: “They dare to attack Sordland. My Sordland! There is a price to pay and they will pay with their lives!”
